title: The Lantern Moth of Questions
statement: A moth of nine pale stars, its wings drawn open in thin silver lines, mistook the dark between worlds for a lamp it had not yet lit. It has circled that blank patch of sky ever since, and each time a child asks why, one wing-star brightens and the moth drifts a little closer to the answer. Look long enough and the empty space in the middle begins to glow.
